-- Deviation: re-runs UIParent_ManageFramePositions after DurabilityFrame's own OnEvent. The -- pass seats the frame 20 further in while a side glyph shows (UIParent.lua:1759-1768), -- but the stock frame runs it only from OnShow/OnHide, so a glyph appearing while the frame -- is shown leaves the shield's overhang off the screen edge. The stock handler runs first, -- unchanged, on the arguments the dispatch passed. if DurabilityFrame then local refOnEvent = DurabilityFrame:GetScript("OnEvent") DurabilityFrame:SetScript("OnEvent", function(self, ...) if refOnEvent then refOnEvent(self, ...) end UIParent_ManageFramePositions() end) end
-- Deviation: every Effects row applies on Okay here, so none asks for a restart or a -- logout. The stock table marks Texture Filtering and Player Texture gameRestart and -- Terrain Texture and Terrain Highlights logout (VideoOptionsPanels.lua:384-399), which -- BlizzardOptionsPanel_OnEvent copies onto the controls at PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD -- (OptionsPanelTemplates.lua:326-329) for VideoOptionsFrame_OnHide's popups and the -- tooltips' requirement line. if EffectsPanelOptions then for _, entry in pairs(EffectsPanelOptions) do entry.gameRestart = nil entry.logout = nil entry.tooltipRequirement = nil end end
